items.title: 7220 ROCKOW RD
items.description: Rarely does a waterfront property offer this combination of privacy, frontage & panoramic views! Situated on a beautifully wooded 1.49 Acre point on FISHER LAKE, part of a 3 lake chain equalling 764 Acres. This log-sided home boasts an impressive 800 feet of frontage on this 441 AC recreational lake. items.title: 7220 ROCKOW RD
items.description: Rarely does a waterfront property offer this combination of privacy, frontage & panoramic views! Situated on a beautifully wooded 1.49 Acre point on FISHER LAKE, part of a 3 lake chain equalling 764 Acres. This log-sided home boasts an impressive 800 feet of frontage on this 441 AC recreational lake. With frontage wrapping around the property and views spanning more than 200 degrees, nearly every window captures the lake, while the generous distance from neighboring homes creates an exceptional sense of privacy. A moderate slope leads to the frontage, with three docks positioned around the property to enjoy different perspectives including a picturesque island just offshore. The home offers wonderful Northwoods character & inviting curb appeal with its log exterior & spacious covered entry. Inside, the main level features 2 bedrooms, including an en suite primary, along with a spacious great room & extended sitting area. Patio doors lead to a private deck, while a brick fireplace adds warmth and character to the living space. One of the home's standout features is the 25x14 three-season porch surrounded by incredible water views--an ideal spot for relaxing, entertaining or even additional sleeping space. From here, step out onto another spacious deck and take in the peaceful surroundings. Upstairs, a fully finished loft with 3rd bedroom (no door) provides additional living or sleeping space along with a convenient half bath. Outside, storage is plentiful with a 3-stall detached garage featuring pull-down attic storage, an additional one-stall garage with electricity, and a lakeside shed perfect for water toys and gear. Located just 9 miles from the quaint Northern town of Mercer & easily accessible year-round, this property offers the privacy of a true Northwoods retreat without sacrificing convenience. This is a property designed to fully embrace lake life.

items.title: ON REED RD
items.description: Discover this exceptional 102-acre private hunting property with the improvements and topography serious outdoor enthusiasts are looking for. Featuring established trails, food plot area, multiple deer stands, and an old hunting shack. This private Northwoods retreat sits directly adjacent to the Nicolet National Forest. The land is not in any Managed forest program and offers easy access to expansive public land and endless opportunities for hunting, recreation, and exploration. Trails are cut in that can be traversed by UTV, a private gate at Reed Rd on parcel TL-1170-2 and shared gate access to easement off Shackleford Rd nearest parcel TL-1158. This opportunity is a rare find in Three Lakes, give a call today to make an appointment to view this superb property.

items.title: 9864 MUD LAKE DR
items.description: Privacy, acreage, and waterfront come together on this beautiful 5.45-acre parcel in Presque Isle! Offering an impressive 359' of south-facing frontage on Mud Lake, a clear 14-acre lake reaching depths of 41', this property is ideal for fishing, swimming, kayaking, and canoeing. Much of the groundwork is already complete with a driveway leading to the building site, electrical set up, a 4-bedroom septic system, and drilled well already in place. Build your private Northwoods lake home or getaway surrounded by the peace and quiet of Wisconsin's Northwoods. The generous acreage also offers excellent hunting and recreational opportunities right out your door. Conveniently located near downtown Boulder Junction with easy access north to Michigan's Upper Peninsula. A rare opportunity to enjoy true Northwoods privacy with substantial waterfront and key improvements already completed. Showings by appointment only.

items.title: 320 AC RIVER RD
items.description: Own a vast, untouched slice of Michigan's Upper Peninsula with this premier 320-acre wilderness tract. Located in a highly sought-after, rugged corridor near the iconic Paint River, this expansive property delivers the ultimate "off-grid" aesthetic and an incredibly remote feel. This is a true sportsman's paradise. It is a premier sanctuary for whitetail deer, black bear, grouse, and turkey. Whether you are looking to establish a legendary family hunting camp, build an off-grid cabin, or simply invest in significant acreage where you can truly escape the modern world, this property delivers on every front. When you aren't exploring your own square-half-mile of land, you are just moments from the blue-ribbon waters of the Paint River, renowned for its excellent trout fishing, kayaking, and pristine canoeing.

items.title: Lot on NO 4 RD
items.description: Heavily 1.29A wooded lot in an area of nice homes and close to town. This is a great location- close to snowmobile and ATV trails, the Gile Flowage, Ski hills and the Hurley/Ironwood area. Bring your plans and build your dream home here!

items.title: 3197 STAWICKI LN
items.description: Enjoy the best of Northwoods living with this inviting 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offering convenient main-level living and a desirable location between Three Lakes and Eagle River. Whether you're looking for a year-round residence, a relaxing vacation getaway, or a waterfront investment, this property offers the opportunity to experience the beauty and recreational lifestyle the Northwoods is known for. The thoughtfully designed layout features comfortable living spaces, three bedrooms, two full baths, and a partial basement providing ample storage. Meticulously maintained home that is completely updated! Outside you will find a lakeside sun deck, permanent pier, large garage, storage shed and black topped driveway. Frontage is on the thoroughfare into Cranberry Lake, part of the renowned Eagle River Chain of Lakes. Step outside and enjoy easy access to boating, fishing, swimming, and endless opportunities to explore both sides of the Three Lakes/ Eagle River Chain. Surrounded by the natural beauty of Wisconsin's Northwoods, this property offers the perfect setting to unwind, entertain, and create lasting memories on the water.

items.title: 5256 HWY 51
items.description: Exceptional turn-key investment and lifestyle opportunity in the heart of Manitowish Waters. Seller financing available for qualified Buyers! This completely renovated 3,200+ sq. ft. community business zoned triplex combines modern luxury, flexible use, and exceptional Northwoods recreation. The property features three beautifully updated units with brand-new high-end furnishings, private exterior entrances, and secure interior connections - allowing the building to operate as three separate rentals or one expansive residential compound. A centrally located common laundry room supports convenient living or efficient rental turnover, while a private gated entrance adds security and privacy. The property is ideally situated near snowmobile trails, biking paths, and a local boat landing providing access to the renowned Manitowish Chain of Lakes for boating, fishing, and watersports. Adding significant versatility is close to an acre behind the building with its own independent access from Townline Road. The additional acreage offers space and potential for outbuildings, detached garages, boat/RV storage, or future development. Community Business zoning provides flexibility for a variety of potential uses, including residential, corporate or long-term rentals, short-term vacation rentals, boutique hospitality, professional office space, or a live/work configuration. Ideal for an investor, hospitality entrepreneur, owner-occupant, or multi-generational family seeking a unique Northwoods property with income and expansion potential. Offered at $897,000, with flexible owner-financing options available to qualified buyers. Great location on USH 51 and WI DOT shows 4,600 vehicles pass per day! A rare combination of luxury, versatility, recreation, and investment potential in one of Wisconsin's premier year-round destinations.

items.title: 727 ELM ST
items.description: Prime commercial opportunity with outstanding visibility along busy State Hwy 51! This well-maintained 1,455 sq ft commercial building offers an inviting, flexible layout suited for a variety of retail, food-related or commercial uses. Constructed in 2011, the property is currently home to Bushel & Crate, a successful farm market, and provides a vision of the versatility this space has to offer. The bright, open-concept retail area is surrounded by windows, creating a welcoming atmosphere with plenty of natural light and excellent merchandising space. An attached yet separate kitchen has been updated and is currently utilized for preparing baked goods, sandwiches, specialty items and catering orders. Additional features include an office, storage areas, walk-in/walk-through cooler, two freezers, gas stove, refrigerator and security system. An attached greenhouse, covered porch and shed further expand the usable space, while raised garden beds and exterior merchandising tables provide additional opportunities outdoors. Ample onsite parking, convenient highway access and strong exposure to both local and passing traffic add to the property's commercial appeal. Located in a popular Northwoods tourism community and positioned among other established businesses, this is an excellent opportunity for an entrepreneur or investor looking for a highly visible property with an adaptable footprint. Sale includes REAL ESTATE ONLY. The Bushel & Crate trade name, business and inventory are not included in the sale. Certain fixtures and equipment, including those noted above, are included with the real estate. With a year round opportunity to create income, now is your time to bring your personal vision to this well established location!

items.title: 2421 GOLDFINCH LN
items.description: A true Northwoods FENCE LAKE getaway with room to share, rent or make entirely your own! Set on a sought-after FENCE LAKE CHAIN a 10-lake chain offering 8,000 acres of recreational water, this charming cottage-style duplex property offers a unique and flexible setup. Each side features 2 bedrooms, 1 bath & a livingroom faced with patio doors to bring the views of the natural surroundings in. Each has an open-concept layout with a a classic brick wood-burning fireplace as its focal point. Use one side and rent the other, create a getaway for multiple families, or explore opening the units into one spacious residence. The fun continues outside! A wraparound deck provides plenty of space for morning coffee, outdoor dining and relaxing while overlooking the lake. Spend summer days boating, fishing, swimming and kayaking, with a new pier already in place for easy access to the entire chain. For your convenience there is a cargo tram that brings your belongings right down to the shoreline for you, no need to carry a thing when your getting ready to enjoy your 125' frontage on crystal clear waters! The lakeside green space offers a fire pit area for evenings spent around the campfire, while additional shared neighborhood green space and a tennis/basketball court provide even more room to enjoy. Need space for guests and all the Northwoods toys? A separate bunkhouse provides 312 sq ft of bonus space for sleeping or a recreational room, plus a laundry room, while the 4-stall garage and additional shed offer exceptional storage. The home is easily accessible year round and only 10 miles from Minocqua for fantastic dining, shopping and entertainment options. Nordic ski trails, snowmbile trails and National Forest lands are abundantly near. Cute, quaint and full of cottage character, this property is turn key and presents so many possibilities--from an income-producing rental to a multi-family retreat or your own waterfront escape.

items.title: 13563 STATELINE LAKE RD
items.description: Charming Year-Round Lakefront Retreat on Stateline Lake! Escape to nature with this 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom year-round waterfront home on the crystal-clear waters of Stateline Lake. Located just minutes from downtown Presque Isle, WI, this property offers the ultimate blend of peaceful Northwoods seclusion and convenient town access. Step inside to a cozy layout designed for easy, single-story lakeside living. The highlight of the home is the screened porch--the absolute perfect spot to drink your morning coffee, enjoy bug-free evenings, and listen to the call of the loons over the water. The home sits on a full, unfinished basement, offering a blank canvas. Use it for abundant storage for all your Northwoods recreation gear, or finish it off to double your living space with a future family room, bunk room, or workshop! Perched on the shores of a 211-acre lake famed for low boat traffic and excellent fishing (walleye, bass, and northern pike), this home is a true dream for anglers and paddlers alike. Whether you are looking for a classic family cabin or a permanent year-round lake home, this Presque Isle gem is ready for its next chapter.

items.title: ON HWY 17
items.description: 7 acre parcel with unlimited possibilities located just minutes from Eagle River. The highly visible & prime location provides easy access off a year round state highway, making it ideal for establishing a new home or business venture. The lot is partially cleared, utilities are readily available and a wide variety of recreational opportunities are abundant and at your fingertips. Make your mark in the Northwoods today!!
